- [USER] User asks how natural and human processes affect the global energy balance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explains that natural processes include solar radiation, Earth's orbit, and volcanic eruptions, while human processes include greenhouse gas emissions, land use changes, and aerosol emissions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant notes that these processes can interact and amplify each other, leading to changes in the global energy balance and shifts in climate.
